$comment: Registry of trip aspects. Each entry maps a source markdown file (matched by `match` regex against the basename) to a canonical aspect `type`, a slide `template`, and extraction `hints`. Adding a new aspect = adding one entry here; no code changes required. Unmatched aspects fall back to `template: generic`.

hints.summary: Recommended multi-hub route, day allocation, transit legs, transit-ratio validation.
fields: map_nodes[] { label, marker, lng, lat, color, labelDy }
hints.notes: map_nodes must use REAL lat/long for each hub city. map_bounds should pad the hub extent by ~8-12 degrees. Pick map_bounds + country highlights from the actual countries visited.

hints.summary: Dedicated flight slide: trip total sidebar, recommended picks, per-leg MCP price panels, search log.
fields: flights { search_date, legs[], trip_total, budget_note, leg_tables[] }
hints.notes: Source: opt-flight-comparison.md or trips/{slug}/flight-comparison.md. Leg tables use Price | Stops | Duration | Airlines | Notes columns.

hints.summary: Dedicated hotel slide: lodging total sidebar, recommended picks per city/hub, booking/rate tables, search log.
fields: hotels { search_date, picks[], total, budget_note, hotel_tables[] }
hints.notes: Source: opt-hotel-comparison.md or trips/{slug}/hotel-comparison.md. SerpAPI MCP tools: search_hotels (per city), get_hotel_details (recommended pick). Tables: Hotel/Property, Price per night, Location/Area, Rating, Notes; MCP search log uses Tool column search_hotels.

hints.summary: Per-city restaurant venue snapshot from SerpAPI TripAdvisor MCP.
fields: venues { search_date, kind, picks[], venue_tables[], search_log }
hints.notes: Source: trips/{slug}/restaurant-comparison.md. SerpAPI MCP tools: search_venues (category=restaurants), get_venue_details (recommended pick). Augments 06-food-dining via enrichFoodDining. Tables: Restaurant, Rating, Reviews, Price, Cuisine, Notes; MCP search log uses Tool column search_venues.

hints.summary: Per-city attractions and hidden-gem snapshot from SerpAPI TripAdvisor MCP.
fields: venues { search_date, kind, picks[], venue_tables[], search_log }
hints.notes: Source: trips/{slug}/attractions-comparison.md. SerpAPI MCP tools: search_venues (category=attractions), get_venue_details (recommended pick). Augments 10-culture-museums and 12-hidden-gems. Tables: Attraction, Rating, Reviews, Type, Notes; MCP search log uses Tool column search_venues.

hints.summary: Per-city spa and wellness picks (resort spas, couples massage, foot massage).
fields: venues { search_date, kind, picks[], venue_tables[], search_log }
hints.notes: Source: trips/{slug}/spa-comparison.md. Tables: Spa, Rating, Price, Type, Duration, Notes. Optional Address column or venue-addresses.json for My Maps. Distill into accommodation/adventure steps when relevant.

hints.summary: Per-city shopping districts, social picks, VAT/customs tables; desk research or MCP.
hints.notes: Source: trips/{slug}/shopping-comparison.md. Distill key tables into opt-06-shopping.md Output. Per-city tables use City: caption prefix for deck slide splitting. Include desk research / social search log.

image_vocabulary.$comment: Controlled vocabulary for the asset library. Stage-1 extraction tags items with one of these category keys; the renderer looks up <category>.svg|png in assets/. Missing categories trigger the AI-gen fallback, then get saved here.
image_vocabulary.map: Data-driven geographic route map (rendered, not a static asset).
